definitions.explanation: Describes movement, reactions, or manner that is slow, heavy, and lacking agility. Often implies a negative quality of being unresponsive or unwieldy.

examples.japanese: {鈍重|どんじゅう}な⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鈍重|どんじゅう}だった。
⟦{官僚|かんりょう}→官僚：02780_kanryou⟧⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鈍重|どんじゅう}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{妨|さまた}げている→妨げる：12223_samatageru⟧。
examples.english: The sluggishness of the bureaucracy is hindering reform.

notes:
Critical in tone: used of people, bodies and especially organizations that are slow to move or respond.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鈍重|どんじゅう}な⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧: slow, heavy movement
- {鈍重|どんじゅう}な⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧: a ponderous organization
- {鈍重|どんじゅう}さ: sluggishness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{緩慢|かんまん}→緩慢：09193_kanman⟧: slow — can be neutral (gradual change); {鈍重|どんじゅう} always adds heaviness and criticism
- ⟦{鈍|にぶ}い→鈍い：00315_nibui⟧: dull, slow — the everyday word, also of blades and pain
- のろい: slow — casual
- ⟦{機敏|きびん}→機敏：09191_kibin⟧: nimble — the opposite
